verdict.rationale: Zoho Invoice documents OAuth 2.0 for authorizing and authenticating API calls, so it does issue its own API credentials that an agent could use. Nothing in the evidence shows scoping or least-privilege controls, and the permanent refresh token cuts against short-lived, tightly bounded agent access. Missing for 10: documented OAuth scopes or per-module/read-only permission limits, a way to issue agent-specific credentials, credential expiry or revocation controls, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent

citations.quote: Zoho REST APIs uses the OAuth 2.0 protocol to authorize and authenticate calls.
The `refresh_token` is permanent and will be used to regenerate new `access_token`, if the current access token is expired.
